prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 50.8 °C (64% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 55.8 °C (55% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.3 °C (47% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.84 s (within 1% of healthy). Valve switching latency remains tightly within normal healthy tolerances.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.57 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 362 W·min/l (6% below healthy). Pump delivers nominal flow rate at baseline electrical input power.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.5 bar (2% below healthy). Hydraulic accumulator effectively dampens load transients with normal pre-charge.
